Sunil Bharti Mittal to receive France's highest civilian honour

Sunil Bharti Mittal, the chairman of Bharti Enterprises, will be awarded France's highest civilian honour, the Chevalier de la Légion d'Honneur, by French President Emmanuel Macron. The award recognizes Mittal's significant contributions to Indo-French relations.
